# Vendor Beta — Security and Data Processing Report

## Company Overview

Vendor Beta provides document workflow automation for enterprise legal and
compliance teams. This report covers both security posture and data
handling practices for the NexusIQ vendor approval process.

## Security Posture

Vendor Beta holds SOC 2 Type II certification, renewed annually (most
recent report dated 4 months ago), and ISO 27001 certification. All
customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using
TLS 1.3.

## Data Residency

All customer data for EU/EEA-domiciled customers is stored and processed
exclusively in Vendor Beta's Frankfurt, Germany data center. No EU/EEA
customer data is transferred outside the EU/EEA at any point in the
processing pipeline. Vendor Beta's data residency questionnaire, filed with
Procurement, confirms this in full.

## Subprocessors

Vendor Beta's complete subprocessor list is published at
subprocessors.vendor-beta.example and includes only EU/EEA-based providers
for any subprocessor with access to EU/EEA customer data. Vendor Beta
provides 45 days' advance notice before adding a new subprocessor, exceeding
the 30-day minimum in DR-11 and the GDPR Compliance Policy.

## Incident Response

Vendor Beta commits to a 4-hour breach notification window for any
confirmed data incident, matching the current Security Policy (SP-102 v2)
requirement.

## Availability

Vendor Beta publishes a documented 99.95% monthly uptime commitment with a
public, API-accessible status page, and maintains a documented RTO of 4
hours and RPO of 15 minutes for production systems.

## Data Processing Agreement

A signed Data Processing Addendum specifying GDPR Article 6 lawful basis is
on file with Procurement, executed 2024-08-01.
